name: GIM

about.text: The Goa Institute of Management (GIM) was established in 1993 with a vision of empowering the youth of India in the management field via knowledge. With its varied range of management courses, the university is focused on filling the gap between the basic information of the field & practical applications. A team of 75+ full-time professors is imparting knowledge to make the business professional understand the impact of business strategies & developments on sustainability & ethical issues.

GIM is accredited by the Association of MBAs (AMBA), Business Graduates Association (BGA), National Board of Accreditation (NBA), SAQS, All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), & Association of Indian Universities (AIU). Moreover, the university is a proud member of the European Foundation for Management Development (EFMD) & Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB). All of these approvals & accreditations give a global reputation to the university for its management courses in both Hybrid & On-Campus modes.

about.text: In the direction of developing a strong understanding of topics in business developers & leaders, the university has introduced a hybrid program wing in the name of GIM Online Active Learning (GOAL). Some of the postgraduate management programs available at the university are also offered via GOAL to make the working professionals equipped with the latest trends & methodologies in the field.

The international collaborations of GIM provide you with global exposure to the business industry. The insights into these trends make you equipped with the ability to understand the emerging practices, models, and technologies in the business world.

facts: The Goa Institute of Management (GIM) was established in 1993 & has become one of the top-rated institutions of management studies in the country.
The university holds the accreditations/membership of AMBA, BGA, NBA, AICTE, AIU, EFMD, SAQS, & AACSB.
The university was listed among the top 4 business schools by Positive Impact Rating 2021.
GIM got selected by the United Nations PRME Champion 2023 for its innovative learning modules.
The university ranked 37 in the management category of NIRF 2024 & 16 in IIRF 2023.
The university also ranked 30th position by India Today in 2022.
The postgraduate diploma in management (PGDM) programs offered in hybrid mode at the university hold equal weightage as full-time PGDM courses.
The specialization areas of PGDM courses available at the university include Healthcare Management, Big Data Analytics, Banking, Insurance, & Financial Services, & many others.
The experienced faculty members & rigorous curriculum of the courses make you learn from basic to advanced concepts of the field via a flexible learning model.
The additional services provided in these hybrid mode courses provide you with global career opportunities.

emi.text: The hybrid PGDM courses are introduced by GIM to make advanced-level education accessible to all. These programs are mainly focused on making the workforce equipped with the analytical training of tools & practical applications of theories. In this direction, the university has also given the extra benefit of easy fee payment options in terms of education loan facilities/No Cost EMIs.
Note: The specifications of these options can be confirmed by visiting the official university website.

admission.text: The process of enrollment into the management programs of GIM is quite simple. The university does conduct screening tests like entrance exams & other aptitude tests for certain programs. This specific criterion must be checked by the students by visiting the official website of the university. A list of the general steps common to all hybrid mode courses is provided here:
Step 1: Visit the official website at which the program is being offered & access the admission portal to get through the application form.
Step 2: Fill out the form with the correct information & submit it along with other academic & professional documents asked by the university.

Step 3: In the case of entrance exam-based programs, you need to clear the exam first with minimum scores pre-decided by the university. The rest of the admission formalities will be applicable only after you make it through the entrance tests.

Step 4: After clearing the entrance exam, if applicable, you will be contacted by the admission committee of the university for some submitting documents like resumes, cover letters, SOPs, LORs, etc. These documents are reviewed by the committee for your background check & to mark your potential for the program.

Step 5: After getting shortlisted in the review procedure, you will be asked for another screening test of an interview. After cracking the interview, you will receive an offer letter from the university with the blocking amount mentioned on it. Payment of the blocking amount before the deadline will ensure your seat in the course.
Step 6: At last, the program fee payment (in your chosen mode) will make mark your seat in the next batch of the course at GIM.

examination.text: The PGDM courses at GIM are designed especially for executives & thus the evaluation criteria of these programs are also based on the performance of candidates on the analytical training apart from the theoretical exams. faqs.q: What is the fee range of online courses at GIM?
faqs.a: The online PGDM courses at the Goa Institute of Management can be completed within the cost range of 1-2 Lakhs. This fee range can vary as per the program chosen, campus immersion chosen or not, fee waivers, & inclusion of GST charges.

faqs.q: Is an online management program from GIM worth it?
faqs.a: The Goa Institute of Management is accredited by AMBA, BGA, NBA, AICTE, etc. Thus, the PGDM courses both in on-campus & hybrid mode offered by it are recognized in industries at a global level.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of pursuing a management program online from GIM?
faqs.a: GIM offers a varied number of PGDM programs through its online active learning platform, GOAL. The updated curriculum, online classes delivered by industry experts, digitized academic resources for self-paced learning, & career assistance boot camps are some of the key benefits of choosing an online course from the Goa Institute of Management.

faqs.q: What are the minimum eligibility criteria to opt for an online management program for executives from the Goa Institute of Management?
faqs.a: At GIM, to enroll in online executive management courses, you need to complete your bachelor’s degree with a minimum aggregate of 50%. You also need to have 3-4 years of work experience in the related domain.

faqs.q: What is the duration of online PGDM programs at GIM?
faqs.a: The PGDM courses are treated as equivalent to MBA but have a short duration. The course duration of an online/hybrid postgraduate diploma in management is between 11 to 24 months at GIM. The exam duration of the program is specialization specific.

faqs.q: What is the salary package after completing the PGDM program at the Goa Institute of Management?
faqs.a: GIM is one of those institutions which have a 100% placement rate. The university reported the highest domestic package for its 2021-2023 session to be 55 LPA. The average package earned by the students of GIM is between 17-20 LPA.
